build: Pytxo CLI 1.3.0 installed from npm (npm i -g pytxo@1.3.0); the 1.3.1 failure lines come from replays of the same branches on a debug build of the branch that became 1.3.1

repo.name: lukeed/mri
repo.tests: tape, 84 assertions; no lockfile, so every check installs dependencies

agents.note: the sandbox keeps .git read-only, so Codex's changes were committed by hand with the agent's own message

fresh_state: each run used a fresh npm prefix, a fresh PYTXO_HOME and a clean clone

runs.name: run 1: two features on the same parser

steps.command: pytxo land claude:claude/double-dash codex:codex/empty-value --per-input --check "npm ci && npm test"
pytxo land claude:claude/double-dash codex:codex/empty-value --per-input --check "npm install && npm test"

runs.note: The first two checks were wrong, not the branches: a fresh worktree has no node_modules and mri has no lockfile. 1.3.0 printed no reason; 1.3.1 prints the failing line and suggests --check "npm install && npm test".

runs.name: run 2: a rename against a new caller

branches.task: rename the internal helper toVal to assign

steps.command: pytxo land claude:claude/rename-helper codex:codex/negated-flags --check "npm install && npm test" --per-input
git switch -q codex/negated-flags && git rebase -q claude/rename-helper
(edit: toVal( -> assign( on the negated-flag line) git commit -q -am "Call assign() after the toVal rename"
pytxo land claude:claude/rename-helper codex:codex/negated-flags --check "npm install && npm test" --per-input
pytxo land claude:claude/rename-helper codex:codex/negated-flags --check "npm install && npm test" --per-input --apply

runs.note: Each branch passed alone; together the new caller called a function the other branch had renamed. The fix commit is 0a1447b. Sharing the landed receipt needs pytxo login, which timed out without a browser approval, so no shared receipt link exists.

ReferenceError: toVal is not defined (under the combined FAIL)

limits: Two runs on one small repository on one Windows host. Not a benchmark and not a rate.
Times are command times only; reading output and fixing code are not included.
npm's package cache was warm for the land checks; a cold npm install took 40.5 s.
The runs used 1.3.0. Failure lines quoted from 1.3.1 come from replays of the same branches on a 1.3.1 debug build.
Checks passing means these commands passed on these exact files, not that the code is correct.
redaction: Receipts are copied verbatim except user-profile paths in check output (C:\Users\<user>). Each receipt's content_digest refers to the unredacted original.
